Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#942)
Many thanks for your [cheque](../others.html#160) which was an agreeable surprise to me. I hope the experiment of cheapness will be successful.

The great day at Hursley is to be the 24th October so if we could have a few of the presentation copies of [John Keble’s parishes](../books.html#247), it would be a great boon

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
